entry.content:
• (API Registry) Removed gcloud api-registry mcp enable and gcloud api-registry mcp disable. MCP server enablement is no longer required; enabling the underlying service is sufficient.
  • (Compute Engine) Removed PRESERVED_STATE column from gcloud compute instance-groups managed list-instances output in beta.
entry.summary: API Registry no longer requires MCP server enablement. Compute Engine has removed the PRESERVED_STATE column from its managed instance group output.
entry.title: Breaking Changes: API Registry and Compute Engine Updates

entry.content: • Route gcloud ai requests for the us multi-region to the Vertex AI multi-regional (REP) endpoint.
entry.summary: Requests to the `gcloud ai` command for the `us` multi-region will now be routed to the Vertex AI multi-regional endpoint. This change ensures optimal performance and reliability for your AI workloads.
entry.title: AI: AI routing update

entry.content: • Added --three-legged-oauth-default-continue-uri flag to gcloud agent-identity auth-providers create and update commands.
entry.summary: New flags for agent identity authentication providers allow setting a default continue URI for three-legged OAuth. This improves the user experience for OAuth flows by directing users to a specified URL after authentication.
entry.title: Agent Identity: Agent Identity Authentication Providers

entry.content:
• Enabled ECP HTTP Proxy support for external users (disabled by default).
  • Added optional --ecp-http-proxy flag to gcloud auth enterprise-certificate-config create to support custom ECP HTTP proxy binary paths.
entry.summary: External users can now leverage ECP HTTP Proxy support, which is disabled by default. A new flag allows for custom ECP HTTP proxy binary paths, providing greater flexibility for authentication configurations.
entry.title: Cloud Auth: Cloud Auth Enhancements

entry.content: • Promoted --master-instance-selection, --master-instance-flexibility-policy-file, --worker-instance-selection, --worker-instance-flexibility-policy-file, --secondary-worker-instance-selection, and --secondary-worker-instance-flexibility-policy-file flags to GA for gcloud dataproc clusters create and gcloud dataproc workflow-templates set-managed-cluster.
entry.summary: We are promoting several flags to General Availability for Dataproc cluster creation and workflow templates. These flags allow for more flexible instance selection and flexibility policies for master, worker, and secondary worker nodes. This provides greater control over cluster resource provisioning.
entry.title: Cloud Dataproc: Dataproc cluster creation enhancements

entry.content: • Added support for --require-indexes and --index-file flags in gcloud emulators firestore start command.
entry.summary: The Firestore emulator now supports the `--require-indexes` and `--index-file` flags. This allows for more consistent local development by enforcing index definitions.
entry.title: Cloud Firestore Emulator: Firestore emulator index support

entry.content:
• Added all-traffic as an allowed value for --direct-vpc-egress flag in gcloud functions deploy.
  • Promoted gcloud functions upgrade command to GA.
entry.summary: New options for VPC egress and general availability for function upgrades are now available for Cloud Functions.
entry.title: Cloud Functions: Cloud Functions updates

entry.content: • Added gcloud netapp volumes start-split and gcloud netapp volumes get-split-status commands to GA track.
entry.summary: New commands for managing NetApp volume split operations are now generally available. Use `gcloud netapp volumes start-split` to initiate a split and `gcloud netapp volumes get-split-status` to monitor its progress.
entry.title: Cloud NetApp: NetApp volume split commands now GA

entry.content: • Promoted gcloud quotas surface (info, preferences, and adjuster settings) to General Availability (GA).
entry.summary: The `gcloud quotas` surface, including info, preferences, and adjuster settings, has been promoted to General Availability (GA). This update provides stable and production-ready access to quota management features.
entry.title: Cloud Quotas: Cloud Quotas Now Generally Available

entry.content: • Modified gcloud sql instances reencrypt to support zero-downtime re-encryption for most Cloud SQL instances, removing the previous downtime warning. Instances using C4, C4A, or N4 machine types are not yet supported for zero-downtime re-encryption; they will still restart during this operation and prompt a downtime warning.
entry.summary: Cloud SQL now supports zero-downtime re-encryption for most instances, eliminating the need for downtime during this process. While instances using C4, C4A, or N4 machine types will still experience a restart, this update significantly improves the re-encryption experience for users.
entry.title: Cloud SQL: Zero-downtime re-encryption for Cloud SQL instances

entry.content: • Updated gcloud beta services mcp enable command to be a no-op, as MCP enablement is no longer required.
entry.summary: The `gcloud beta services mcp enable` command is now a no-op. MCP enablement is no longer required for this service.
entry.title: Cloud Services: Service enablement update

entry.content:
• Fixed an issue where the default zone for cluster resources (storage, network, etc.) was always set to the location's "b" zone, overriding the user-specified zone in compute flags.
  • Renamed --blueprint flag to --reference-architecture in gcloud beta cluster-director clusters create.
entry.summary: Cluster Director has been updated with a fix for default zone selection for cluster resources, ensuring user-specified zones are respected. Additionally, the `--blueprint` flag has been renamed to `--reference-architecture` for clarity in cluster creation commands.
entry.title: Cluster Director: Cluster Director fixes and flag updates

entry.content:
• Promoted gcloud compute hosts and gcloud compute reservations hosts to GA.
  • Updated gcloud compute reservations hosts list and gcloud compute reservations hosts describe to require --reservation when --reservation-block is specified.
  • Added support for 3500GB, and 7000GB partition sizes when creating local SSDs via gcloud compute instances create and gcloud compute instance-templates create.
  • Promoted --igmp-query flag in --network-interface of gcloud compute instance-templates create to GA.
  • Promoted --igmp-query flag in gcloud compute instances network-interfaces add to GA.
  • Promoted --igmp-query flag in --network-interface of gcloud compute instances bulk create to GA.* Added gcloud compute http-health-checks test-iam-permissions command.
  • Added --routing-mode flag to gcloud compute service-attachments create and update commands in beta.
  • Added gcloud compute snapshot-groups test-iam-permissions command in beta release track.
  • Added gcloud compute instances test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a Compute Engine virtual machine instance in GA, beta, and preview.
  • Added gcloud compute interconnects groups set-iam-policy command to set IAM policy on an interconnect group in beta, preview, and GA.
  • Added --exapool-capacity-optimized-capacity, --exapool-read-optimized-capacity, and --exapool-write-optimized-capacity flags to gcloud alpha compute storage-pools update for Exapool storage pools.
  • Added Arm CCA support to the confidential-compute-type option in gcloud compute instance create.
  • Added gcloud compute network-firewall-policies test-iam-permissions command.
  • Added gcloud compute disks test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a Compute Engine disk.
  • Promoted --ipv6-network-tier flag of gcloud compute networks subnets create and gcloud compute networks subnets update to beta.
  • Added STANDARD option to --ipv6-network-tier flag of gcloud compute instances create, gcloud compute instance-templates create, gcloud compute instances network-interfaces add, and gcloud compute instances network-interfaces update in beta.
  • Added gcloud compute routers test-iam-permissions command to test specific IAM permissions on a Compute Engine router in beta.
entry.summary: New features and GA promotions for Compute Engine command-line tools. This update includes enhancements to instance creation, network interface management, storage pools, and IAM permission testing.
entry.title: Compute Engine: Compute Engine CLI Updates

entry.content: • Promoted new ULL_POLICY value for --policy-type flag of gcloud compute network-firewall-policies create to GA.
entry.summary: We are excited to announce that the new ULL_POLICY value for the --policy-type flag of `gcloud compute network-firewall-policies create` has been promoted to General Availability. This update enhances our network security capabilities, providing more robust and scalable firewall policy management.
entry.title: Compute Firewall Policies: Compute Firewall Policies Now Generally Available

entry.content: • Promoted gcloud edge-cloud zones list to GA.
entry.summary: The `gcloud edge-cloud zones list` command is now generally available, allowing users to easily discover and manage Edge Cloud zones. This feature enhances the usability of Distributed Cloud Edge by providing a streamlined way to interact with your edge infrastructure.
entry.title: Distributed Cloud Edge: Edge Cloud Zones Now Generally Available

entry.content: • Promoted gcloud container fleet|hub config-management update command to beta.
entry.summary: The `gcloud container fleet config-management update` command has been promoted to the beta release. This update signifies improved stability and introduces new features for managing your GKE configurations.
entry.title: GKE Hub: Config Management Command Promoted to Beta

entry.content:
• Added gcloud iam access-policies create|delete|describe|list|update|search-policy-bindings commands to allow management of access policy resources.
  • Added --target-resource flag to gcloud iam policy-bindings create.
entry.summary: New gcloud commands are available for managing access policy resources. You can now create, delete, describe, list, update, and search access policies and their bindings. The `--target-resource` flag has also been added to `gcloud iam policy-bindings create`.
entry.title: Identity and Access Management: Manage access policies with gcloud

entry.content: • Updated kpt to v1.0.0-beta.67. See https://github.com/kptdev/kpt/releases/tag/v1.0.0-beta.67 for more details.
entry.summary: The kpt tool has been updated to version v1.0.0-beta.67. This release includes various improvements and bug fixes. For a detailed list of changes, please refer to the release notes.
entry.title: Kpt: kpt updated to v1.0.0-beta.67

entry.content:
• Updated default kubectl to 1.35.6.
  • Additional kubectl versions:
  • 1.30.14
  • 1.31.14
  • 1.32.13
  • 1.33.13
  • 1.34.10
  • 1.35.7
  • 1.36.3
entry.summary: We have updated the default kubectl version in Kubernetes Engine to 1.35.6. Several other kubectl versions are also available, including 1.30.14 through 1.36.3, to provide flexibility for your deployments.
entry.title: Kubernetes Engine: Kubernetes Engine kubectl updates

entry.content:
• Deprecated clientTlsPolicy field in gcloud network-services endpoint-policies.
  • Updated gcloud network-services endpoint-policies resource name pattern to support regional locations.
entry.summary: The `clientTlsPolicy` field in endpoint policies is now deprecated. The resource name pattern for endpoint policies has also been updated to better support regional locations.
entry.title: Network Services: Endpoint Policies Update

entry.content:
• Added --kms-key flag to gcloud vmware private-clouds create. Specifying this flag with a valid KMS key resource name enables CMEK.
  • Added --encryption-type and --kms-key flags to gcloud vmware private-clouds update. --kms-key (valid KMS key resource name) is required when --encryption-type is CMEK.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.
entry.summary: VMware Engine now supports Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) for private clouds. You can enable CMEK during private cloud creation or update an existing private cloud to use CMEK by specifying a valid KMS key.
entry.title: Vmware Engine: VMware Engine adds CMEK support
